items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: All those wonderful Nestico arrangements that nobody plays them like the Basie band

ctx.x: A couple of the players have mentioned — that we’ve seen — that they had never played in any other bands that could swing at a soft and slow tempo like that. That’s one of the hardest things for bands to do, is to be soft and slow but still be happening.
All those wonderful Nestico arrangements that nobody plays them like the Basie band, all of those, “Queen Bee” and lovely things that he arranged. Terrific.
Well there’s a whole library of stuff that nobody plays like Basie. Even the current Basie band doesn’t play it as well as they were. Although the new Basie band is not all that bad.
